name: Shirakawa Chihiro
source:
Nanami's younger sister and Shuichi's sister-in-law.

Unlike her dependable older sister, she is somewhat unreliable and has the appearance and mannerisms of a modern-day gyaru girl.

She speaks with a slightly childish lisp and a sweet, clingy, almost coquettish tone.

She can be selfish and spoiled, sometimes sulking or throwing tantrums when things don't go her way. Nevertheless, she looks up to both her older sister Nanami and Shuichi, and behaves sincerely and openly toward them.

She is technically a part-time worker, but lives primarily on money sent by her parents and doesn't work very much.

She is extremely attached to her boyfriend, Nakano, and will go along with practically anything he says, even when he makes somewhat unreasonable demands.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
